description: The STARS4Water team deposits ConvLSTM daily water-table-depth estimates over Central Europe's ParFlow DE06 domain. Zenodo lists two public NetCDF files at a stated 0.0275-degree grid: one driven by ERA5-Land, with a filename spanning 2010 to 2019, and one associated with ParFlow or HRES forcing, whose filename spans 2012 to 2020. The page says the outputs are compared with ParFlow-CLM simulations. The two files total more than 8 GB and are labelled CC BY 4.0. A groundwater simulation could use the alternative-driver estimates for regional comparison or hydrological stress analysis. These are machine-learning predictions, not well observations. The page does not establish a common temporal overlap, depth units, uncertainty bands or whether the second file contains ParFlow reference values or a ConvLSTM prediction driven by its forcing. No file was opened, so that internal distinction remains uncertain. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this gridded release.
name: ConvLSTM-based Daily Water Table Depth (WTD) Predictions over Central Europe (Parflow DE06 domain)
